text:
nora: quick status from the tiny-embed onboarding run. tested float32 baseline, int8-ptq, and int4-perchannel. short summary + next steps below.

embed-ci-bot: run 4765432101 summary (tiny-embed-v0.9)
- f32 baseline: R@1=0.715 R@5=0.891 R@10=0.929 silhouette=0.52
- int8-ptq: R@1=0.707 R@5=0.884 R@10=0.923 silhouette=0.51
- int4-per-channel: R@1=0.664 R@5=0.840 R@10=0.897 silhouette=0.43
- short-queries bucket (median len=28): f32 R@1=0.603, int4 R@1=0.549

sam: int4 dropping R@1 by ~5.4 pts overall; short queries hit harder.

hugo: eval command used:
```bash
./eval/bench.sh --model tiny-embed-v0.9 --quant perchannel_int4 --holdouts recall_short,recall_wiki --index hnsw --k 10 --seed 7
```

raj: hypothesis: calibration set underrepresents punctuation-heavy short queries and rare subwords. propose re-calib with stratified tail sampling and try asymmetric scales.

nora: agreed. action items: 1) rerun per-channel int4 with stratified calibration (tail-focused) 2) run int8-QAT warmstart for 5 epochs on stratified samples 3) collect per-query NN reorder diffs and small human pack (150 queries) for UX check.

embed-ci-bot: queued job 4765432400 (int4 stratified calib). ETA ~22m. artifacts will be posted.

sam: if stratified recovers >0.025 R@1 on short bucket we can gate int4 behind a routing rule: short-query->int8, else keep int8 default.

hugo: I'll prepare scripts to compute per-query neighbor-preservation and log the top changed tokens.

nora: thanks team. we'll reconvene on results and decide gating policy.
